title: SearchIntent
description: Producer: stage 01. Consumer: stage 02/03. additionalProperties:false is the hallucination gate. Stage 01 output. Grounded only in the user's words plus the committed SYNONYMS map. Stage 01 never geocodes and never invents products.

raw_query.description: Exactly what the user typed. Never altered.

keywords.description: Terms from the user's words or SYNONYMS map rows only.

category_hints.description: Zero or more hints. Empty array = search all categories.

location_text.description: Place name verbatim from the query, else null. Not geocoded here.
